sources.entry: macGist - Simple app to send pasteboard items to GitHub's Gist.

summary.one_liner: macGist is a small macOS app that uploads the clipboard contents to GitHub Gist and replaces the clipboard with the resulting Gist URL.
summary.what_it_does: The app takes whatever is on the macOS pasteboard and sends it to GitHub Gist as a new gist. It then copies the Gist URL back into the clipboard, overwriting the original contents. Users can log in to their GitHub account so gists are created as authenticated (tied to the account). A settings option turns notifications on when an upload finishes; it is off by default. The app also includes a view of the user's gist list. The README includes screenshots of the app, settings panel, and gist list, but gives no further technical detail.
use_cases: share clipboard text as a gist
quickly get a shareable link for copied code
upload snippets to GitHub Gist from macOS
send pasteboard contents to GitHub without a browser
how_to_run: Download an unsigned version of the app from the link in the README
notable: Copies the new Gist URL straight back to the clipboard
Optional GitHub login for authenticated gists
Notifications on upload, off by default
caveats: Replaces the current clipboard contents with the Gist URL, so the original clipboard is lost
Distributed as an unsigned build, which macOS may warn about
README gives no details on supported macOS versions or build steps
